title: Finite locally free tensor-pullback unit
statement: Let $p:X\to Y$ be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme]. For the canonical tensor-pullback adjunction [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction], suppose the unit on $\mathcal O_Y$ is invertible. Then the unit on any finite locally free $\mathcal O_Y$-module $N$ [def-sc-finite-locally-free-sheaf] is invertible.

source.place: Tag 01E8, degree-zero projection formula and local finite-free proof; Tag 0BDP, projection-formula paragraph

proof.text: Extract locally free local generators q with finite index sets from [def-sc-finite-locally-free-sheaf]. Their opens q.X cover Y and each generator map is an isomorphism from a finite coproduct of the restricted structure module.

On each q.X i, apply [lem-sc-tensor-unit-open-localization] to obtain an additive local functor H, transformation α and comparison θ for the canonical unit [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. Restrict the assumed isomorphism on the structure module. Cancel the component of θ to deduce that α at the local structure module is an isomorphism.

The private Lean lemma isIso_app_coproduct proves by coproduct hom-ext and naturality that α at a coproduct of copies of O is Sigma.map of the α_O components followed by the coproduct comparison isomorphism. Additivity preserves finite coproducts. Hence α on the finite free module is invertible, including an empty index set. NatTrans.isIso_app_iff_of_iso transports this along the local generator isomorphism. The equation furnished by localization and θ then imply invertibility of the restricted original unit.

Forget to abelian sheaves and apply Mathlib Sheaf.isIso_of_coversTop to q.coversTop. The underlying sheaf functor reflects isomorphisms, as follows from Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf and reflectsIsomorphisms_of_comp. Reflect the isomorphism to obtain the original unit is invertible. All these steps are written in Lean; no gluing lemma is left as a hole.

theorem isIso_tensorPullback_unit_of_finiteLocallyFree {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (p : X ⟶ Y)
    (hO : IsIso ((Classical.choose (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction p)).unit.app
      (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf)))
    (N : Y.Modules) [N.IsFiniteLocallyFree] :
    IsIso ((Classical.choose (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction p)).unit.app N)
